d:
Jharkhand men mahila aayog ki adhyaksh ke aaropon ko lekar siyasat garma gaee hai. is mudde par JMM, BJP aur kangres ke netaon ke bich jubani jang tej ho gaee hai. tinon dalon ke netaon ne ek-dusre par jamkar nishana sadha aur apne-apne tark rakhe.
Aakhir mahila aayog ki adhyaksh ne kya aarop lagae? in aaropon par JMM, BJP aur kangres ne kya kaha? dekhie is pure rajnitik vivad par netaon ki pratikriya.
